articles.description:
I was digging through React's source code and stumbled upon some bitmask logic for handling component states. At first glance, it looked cryptic—just a bunch of &, |, and << operators. But once I understood what was happening, it clicked. These operations are ridiculously fast and efficient.
Here are some tricks I find myself reaching for when performance actually matters.
To set the bit at position pos, use the bitwise OR operator. Think of (1 << pos) as a laser pointer—you're pointing it exactly at one spot, and | is the "turn on" switch:
function setBit(n: number, pos: number): number {
  return n | (1 << pos);
}

Example: Setting bit at position 2 in 0b1010 gives us 0b1110
   0b1010
 | 0b0100  (laser pointer at position 2)
-----------
   0b1110

To clear a bit at position pos, we AND w…
articles.title: Handy Bit Manipulation Tricks

What I Built
I built TestPilot AI, an AI-augmented Playwright test runner that automatically diagnoses failing tests and suggests fixes using the GitHub Copilot SDK and CLI.
The project’s main goal is to reduce the time developers spend debugging failing tests. Instead of manually inspecting error messages or stack traces, TestPilot AI sends failure details to Copilot, which analyzes the failure, identifies the root cause, classifies the issue (e.g., flaky test, locator change, API failure), and even provides a suggested code fix or improved test snippet.
For me, this project demonstrates how Copilot can act as a real development partner — not just generating code, but actively helping debug and optimize tests in real time.

articles.description:
The End of Watching. The Beginning of Living.
That era is dead. Welcome to Synthia (The 11th Art). It’s not "AI video." It’s not "fake film." It is a Living Substrate—a digital sandbox where your wildest, most impossible imagination becomes a physical, breathable reality in real-time.
Your Life, The Blockbuster
In the AI Revolution, we aren't just making movies; we are turning Your Life into the Greatest Story Ever Told. * The Hero Upgrade: Imagine a world where your daily walk is rendered as a scene from a sci-fi epic, or your morning coffee is shared with a Neural Thespian version of your favorite historical icon.
Sovereign Fun: You don’t need a $200 million studio. You are the studio. You are the star. You are the "Sovereign Auteur" of your own Saturday night.
Synthia: The Ultimate Theme Park (In Your Pocket)
Why go to a theme park when you can be the theme park?
Recursive Reality: Synthia is the first medium that listens to you. It’s "Smart Cinema." If you’re feeling bold, the movie gets faster. If you’re feeling romantic, the lighting shifts to a sunset that never ends.
The "Dayem Constant": This is our secret sauce. It’s the law that ensures the AI never takes over—it stays Human-Centric. It means the fun is always your fun, tailored to your soul, not a generic algorithm.
The Death of Boredom
In the Intelligence Age, boredom is a bug, and we’ve just released the patch.
Infinite Content? No. Infinite Context. * We are building the Existential Substrate—a world where every object has a story, every person has a digital "Legend," and every moment is an opportunity for Ethereal Play.
Don’t Just Witness the Revolution—Lead It.
The "AI Boom" isn't about robots taking jobs; it’s about Humans taking back their Wonder. We are moving from a world of "Content" to a world of "Experience." I am codifying the rules of this new world not to restrict it, but to ensure it stays fun, safe, and breathtakingly beautiful. Welcome to Synthia. Your seat is gone. The stage is yours.
